integrity.finite_checks: 150 exact assertions from enumeration of 46,230 permutations for n=3..8.
integrity.general_proof: Analytic rank-independence and conditional integral proof for all n>=3.
integrity.review: Self-review only; no independent audit or external certification.

scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations or ranks of iid continuous observations only; exact covariance is not an independence claim. Historical joint enumeration could contain an earlier equivalent formula; Warren and Seneta (1996) full text was inaccessible, so absence from that paper is not asserted.
title: A three-diagonal covariance law for permutation records and peaks
